entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message received by the UE during PDU session authentication and authorization procedure.

entities.name: PDU session ID
entities.description: Identifier for a PDU session included in the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.

entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE
entities.description: State of a PDU session when it is inactive in the UE.

entities.name: 5GSM STATUS
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to indicate 5GSM status with cause information.

entities.name: 5GSM cause #43
entities.description: 5GSM cause IE set to value #43 indicating 'Invalid PDU session identity'.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to release a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure involving PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message for authentication and authorization.

entities.name: PDU session inactive for received PDU session ID
entities.description: Condition where the PDU session ID in PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND belongs to a PDU session in PDU SESSION INACTIVE state.

entities.name: Collision of UE-requested PDU session release and PDU session authentication
entities.description: Condition where PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND is received during UE-requested PDU session release for the same PDU session.

entities.name: Ignore PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: UE behavior to ignore the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and proceed with UE-requested PDU session release.

relations.description: Condition of inactive PDU session leads to sending 5GSM STATUS message.
5GSM STATUS message contains 5GSM cause IE set to #43.
Condition requires PDU session to be in PDU SESSION INACTIVE state.
PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message contains PDU session ID.
Collision condition leads to ignoring PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND and proceeding with release.
Collision condition requires UE-requested PDU session release procedure to be ongoing.
Collision condition involves PDU session authentication and authorization procedure.
